definitions: A sticky, colourless film of bacteria that forms on teeth.
An ornamental plate, slab, or tablet, typically of metal, porcelain, or wood, fixed to a wall or other surface in commemoration of a person or event.
A small, abnormal patch on a body part or surface, especially on the skin or in the brain.
examples: Brush your teeth to remove plaque.
A blue plaque marks the house where he lived.
Amyloid plaques are found in the brains of Alzheimer's patients.
